It checks all support degrees \(4,\ldots,28\); the quotient free ranks are \(1,1,2,1,1\) in degrees \(4,\ldots,8\), zero thereafter, and every torsion list is empty. Thus it independently re-executes the finite calculation yielding \(J_{2,5}/\Lambda_+J_{2,5}\cong\mathbb Z^6\). Its independence is re-execution independence, not an independent implementation, since its script digest equals task 132’s script digest. Combined with the accepted generation result, \(a=b=2\) gives two six-element generating families. Each induces a surjection \(\mathbb Z^6\to\mathbb Z^6\), hence an isomorphism. Every generating set must surject onto this quotient and therefore has at least six elements. Consequently both families are irredundant and minimum-cardinality generating sets. The named \(i=j=p=2,\ c=5\) minimality corollary is therefore established relative to the accepted project inputs.
